title: Cisco security advisory (AV26-932)
description: As of September 16, 2026, Cisco is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software
	Prior to 7.0.10, 7.2.12, 7.4.8, 7.6.6, 7.7.13, 10.0.2 and 10.1.0

Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software
	Prior to 7.0.10, 7.2.12, 7.4.8, 7.6.6, 7.7.13, 10.0.2 and 10.1.0

Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) Software
	Prior to 3.1 Patch 12, 3.2 Patch 11, 3.3 Patch 12, 3.4 Patch 7 and 3.5 Patch 4
Prior to 3.1 Patch 12, 3.2 Patch 11, 3.3 Patch 12, 3.4 Patch 7 and 3.5 Patch 4

Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) Software
	Prior to 3.1 Patch 12, 3.2 Patch 11, 3.3 Patch 12, 3.4 Patch 7 and 3.5 Patch 4
Prior to 3.1 Patch 12, 3.2 Patch 11, 3.3 Patch 12, 3.4 Patch 7 and 3.5 Patch 4

Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software
	Prior to 9.16.4.103, 9.18.4.94, 9.20.4.49, 9.22.3.26, 9.23.1.47 and 9.24.1.26
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
